sql_reading_A.sql:
WITH math_subjects AS (
    SELECT
        s.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
        s.SUBJECT_ID,
        s.TOTAL_UNITS
    FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED s
    WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND s.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y'
      AND UPPER(s.GRADE_TYPE) = 'LETTER'
),
course_subject_counts AS (
    SELECT
        sc.COURSE_NUMBER,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count
    FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE sc
    JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION cd
      ON cd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER
    WHERE sc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
      AND cd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    GROUP BY sc.COURSE_NUMBER
)
SELECT
    'Mathematics' AS department_name,
    AVG(ms.TOTAL_UNITS) AS average_total_units,
    VARIANCE(ms.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance,
    MAX(c.subject_code_count) - MIN(c.subject_code_count) AS subject_code_count_range,
    VARIANCE(c.subject_code_count) AS subject_code_count_variance,
    STDDEV(c.subject_code_count) AS subject_code_count_standard_deviation
FROM math_subjects ms
CROSS JOIN course_subject_counts c;
